title: Hamburger Horizons
description: This modpack aims for a Medieval-RPG style, made for a small friend group and focus's on Optimization and Fun.
body:
**## ⚔️ HAMBURGER HORIZONS**

This modpack is intented for a minecraft (friends only) server called Hamburger Horizons which needed a modpack with good optimization and lots of fun mechanics.

This modpack aims for an RPG style, with custom mobs, custom world gen, and last but not least 100's of custom structures. 

Wether you play with your friends or in a solo singleplayer world, this pack will work for you just fine.
